filiereNoire.title: The Black Pipeline
filiereNoire.lore: Boro doesn't entrust you with his life out of friendship. He gives you this mission because he needs an outsider — someone whose name isn't on any Falcon list. Yet.

fn1.title: The first contact
fn1.description: Boro has a delivery that has to go through Black Relay. No questions. Pickup within 48h. He gives you the coordinates.

fn2.title: The contact on site
fn2.description: Setta at Black Relay is waiting for you. She knows your name — you didn't tell her. The delivery is accepted without inspection. She gives you an address: Shadow Station.
fn2.objective: Talk to Setta (visit Black Relay and meet Setta)
fn2.rewardMsg: Setta notes your face. This won't be the last time.

fn3.title: The ghost operation
fn3.description: Shadow Station. Officially nonexistent. Kross is waiting with a simple mission: watch a transfer and don't intervene. Unless it goes wrong.
fn3.objective: Travel to Shadow Station and meet Kross

fn4.title: The transfer under pressure
fn4.description: The transfer goes wrong. Interceptors attack. Kross escapes. You have to handle it.
fn4.objective: Win a fight at Shadow Station

fn5.title: Reporting to Boro
fn5.description: Back to the Bas-Fonds. Boro needs to hear what happened. He needs to know if you're someone he can rely on.

fn6.title: The truth about the pipeline
fn6.description: Boro reveals that this whole operation was a Black Falcons test. You were working for Alanossa without knowing it. Now you have a choice.
fn6.objective: Join the Black Falcons or refuse
fn6.rewardMsg: ★★ The Black Pipeline complete. +8000cr, +40 rep. The Black Falcons have assessed you.

heritageVelkor.title: Velkor's Legacy
heritageVelkor.lore: Velkor wasn't a scientist. That's what Ysla understood after months in the ruins of his station. What he really was is buried in archives no one has dared read in full.

hv1.title: The first leads
hv1.description: Ysla found fragments in the lower levels of the Abyss. She needs you to explore deeper than she can go alone.

hv2.title: The Cradle
hv2.description: The fragments point to The Cradle — an ancient station that seems to have been the origin of something. Ysla has never been there. She sends you in her place.
hv2.objective: Travel to The Cradle and explore its archives
hv2.rewardMsg: +1200cr. Archivist Zal holds pieces of the puzzle.

hv3.title: Lira's data
hv3.description: Archivist Zal has encrypted archives he can't open. Lira at Nexus Aldara might be able to — if you can convince her.
hv3.objective: Go to Nexus Aldara and talk to Lira
hv3.rewardMsg: Lira reluctantly agrees. She has her own questions about Velkor.

hv4.title: The guardians of truth
hv4.description: Someone doesn't want these archives opened. Agents have been sent to stop you. They know where you are.
hv4.objective: Survive an attack (win a fight at Nexus Aldara)
hv4.rewardMsg: +2000cr, +20 rep. You have their attention now.

hv5.title: The final revelation
hv5.description: Back to the Abyss with the decrypted data. Velkor wasn't just a scientist — he was mapping something no one was ever meant to find. The final report to Ysla.
hv5.objective: Return to the Abyss and find Ysla

hv6.title: The final confrontation
hv6.description: Those who protect Velkor's secret arrive in person. Ysla is in danger. You have to stop them.
hv6.objective: Defeat the boss of the Abysses of Velkor
hv6.rewardMsg: ★★ Velkor's Legacy complete. +12000cr, +50 rep, legendary weapon.

vengeanceOssian.title: Ossian's Vengeance
vengeanceOssian.lore: Brother Ossian the Last had students. They never accepted his death. Torvak knows them. He also knows what they're planning.

vo1.title: The Ossian file
vo1.description: Torvak explains the situation: three of Ossian's heirs are preparing retaliation against anyone who played a role in his death — including you if you crossed their path. They must be neutralized first.
vo1.rewardMsg: Torvak gives you names. Stations. Methods.

vo2.title: The first heir
vo2.description: Ossian's first heir operates out of Fort Ossian — he's turned part of the garrison to his cause. Orva can help you identify him.
vo2.objective: Go to Fort Ossian, meet Orva
vo2.rewardMsg: +1500cr. Orva points you to the first heir.

vo3.title: The purge of Fort Ossian
vo3.description: The first heir must be stopped. He won't step down willingly.
vo3.objective: Win a fight at Fort Ossian

vo4.title: The second heir
vo4.description: The second has rallied forces at The Exiled Fortress. Keln might have information — he knows the networks of the old Guardians.
vo4.objective: Visit The Exiled Fortress and talk to Keln
vo4.rewardMsg: +1000cr. Keln has his own reasons to want this settled.

vo5.title: The Forteresse Exilée
vo5.description: The second heir is entrenched. The confrontation is inevitable.
vo5.objective: Defeat the boss of The Exiled Fortress

vo6.title: Reporting to Torvak
vo6.description: Back to Fort Kharos. The last heir surrendered — or vanished. Torvak needs to hear what happened.
vo6.rewardMsg: ★★ Ossian's Vengeance complete. +10000cr, +45 rep. The Guardians owe you a debt.

couronneVide.title: The Crown and the Void
couronneVide.lore: Someone at The Crown of Eos is feeding information to Alanossa. Ulmo can't lead the investigation himself — too visible. You're perfect: skilled enough to succeed, foreign enough not to be suspected.

cv1.title: Ulmo's mission
cv1.description: Ulmo tells you decisions made at La Couronne reach Alanossa's ears before they're even voted on. The traitor is high-ranking. You need proof.
cv1.objective: Meet Ulmo (visit The Crown of Eos)
cv1.rewardMsg: Ulmo gives you a first lead: the information passes through the Private Club.

cv2.title: Infiltrating the Club
cv2.description: Eos Private Club is the only place the traitor can transmit discreetly. Sael, the maître d'hôtel, sees everything — but he doesn't talk for free.
cv2.objective: Visit Eos Private Club and talk to Sael
cv2.rewardMsg: +2000cr. Sael saw something. He tells you what he can.

cv3.title: Lady Sonn knows
cv3.description: One of the names Sael mentioned frequents the Orbital Residence. Lady Sonn, who's lived there for thirty years, knows everyone. She can identify him.
cv3.objective: Talk to Lady Sonn at the Orbital Residence
cv3.rewardMsg: Lady Sonn gives you a name. She looks relieved to finally tell someone.

cv4.title: The traitor's agents
cv4.description: The traitor learned an investigation is underway. Agents have been sent to shut it down.
cv4.objective: Survive the attack (win a fight at The Crown of Eos)

cv5.title: The final confrontation
cv5.description: The traitor tries to flee to Scotty Golden North. You have to intercept him.
cv5.objective: Win a fight at Scotty Golden North
cv5.rewardMsg: The traitor is neutralized. The evidence is secured.

cv6.title: Reporting to Ulmo
cv6.description: Back to La Couronne. Ulmo is waiting. The question is: what to do with this evidence?
cv6.objective: Return to The Crown of Eos
cv6.rewardMsg: ★★ The Crown and the Void complete. +15000cr, +60 rep. Alanossa has lost a valuable source.

routeCendres.title: The Ash Road
routeCendres.lore: Murn survived the fire. He saw what no one else saw: the flames didn't come from a malfunction. They came from someone. Twenty years later, he wants to know who.

rc1.title: The fire and its witnesses
rc1.description: Murn shares his suspicions: the fire at The Ashes was deliberate. He kept a fragment of the original structure — someone can analyze it.
rc1.rewardMsg: Murn gives you the fragment. 'Find out who did this.'

rc2.title: Docta's analysis
rc2.description: Quarantine Station is home to Docta — a doctor who has also analyzed unusual materials in the past. He can identify the fragment's origin.
rc2.objective: Go to Quarantine Station, talk to Docta
rc2.rewardMsg: +800cr. Docta identifies a rare chemical signature — industrial.

rc3.title: The industrial lead
rc3.description: The signature points to The Refinery or The Black Forge. Brenn at The Refinery might recognize the component.
rc3.objective: Go to The Refinery, talk to Brenn
rc3.rewardMsg: Brenn recognizes the component. He looks uneasy. 'This is old. Really old.'

rc4.title: Those who protect the secret
rc4.description: Brenn let slip a name before clamming up. That name leads to The Living Wreck — and to those who've been hiding archives there for twenty years.
rc4.objective: Win a fight at The Living Wreck

rc5.title: The one who ordered it
rc5.description: The archives reveal the fire was commissioned from Night Port — the Night King of the time had reasons. You must confront the current one.
rc5.objective: Defeat the boss of Night Port
rc5.rewardMsg: +4000cr. The chain of command comes to the surface.

rc6.title: The truth for Murn
rc6.description: Back to The Ashes. Murn has waited twenty years. He deserves the truth — even if it's more complicated than he imagined.
rc6.rewardMsg: ★★ The Ash Road complete. +9000cr, +40 rep. Murn can finally leave this place.

carnageControle.title: Controlled Carnage
carnageControle.lore: Vix is what's known as an independent fixer — no affiliation, no loyalty, just clean work. What he's offering you is far from clean: an anonymous contract to decapitate the sector's four factions. Simultaneously. The client stays in the shadows. The pay is real, though.

cc1.title: Vix's proposal
cc1.description: Vix waits for you at The Wreckyard with a sealed envelope. A contract: four factions, four leaders, four deaths. Any order. Payment on completion. He gives you coordinates and a line: 'You don't need to know why. You just need to be better than them.'
cc1.objective: Talk to Vix at The Wreckyard
cc1.rewardMsg: +2000cr — Vix's advance. He watches you leave without a word.

cc2.title: Alanossa — Black Falcons
cc2.description: West Apocalypse Arc. Alanossa's territory. She runs the Black Falcons from this station — the whole network flows through her. You have to go there and finish what started.
cc2.objective: Defeat Alanossa at West Apocalypse Arc
cc2.rewardMsg: +5000cr, +20 rep. The Black Falcons are in shock. A leader like that isn't easily replaced.

cc3.title: Commander Zara Sable — Scarlet Guardians
cc3.description: The Scarlet Citadel. Commander Zara Sable coordinates all Guardian military operations from this bastion. She won't come out on her own — you have to go in.
cc3.objective: Defeat Commander Zara Sable at The Scarlet Citadel
cc3.rewardMsg: +5000cr, +20 rep. The Citadel is silent. For the first time in years.

cc4.title: The Ghost Broker — Emporium
cc4.description: Emporium Requiem. The head of the Emporium operates in the shadows from this trade hub. No one knows their real name. Vix gave you enough information to find them.
cc4.objective: Defeat the Ghost Broker at Emporium Requiem
cc4.rewardMsg: +6000cr, +25 rep. The Emporium collapses from within. Markets are in panic.

cc5.title: Director Pale — Cult of the Void
cc5.description: The Abysses of Velkor. Director Pale controls the Cult from this station lost at the edge of the sector. The journey is long. He doesn't expect visitors.
cc5.objective: Defeat Director Pale at the Abysses of Velkor
cc5.rewardMsg: +6000cr, +25 rep. Four factions. Four leaders. Zero regrets.

cc6.title: The Tally is Settled
cc6.description: Vix waits for you at The Wreckyard. He looks like he already knows. The client sent the balance — they never show themselves in person. Of course. You did something no one had ever done: decapitate the entire sector in a single run.
cc6.objective: Return to The Wreckyard — collect the balance
cc6.rewardMsg: ★★ CONTROLLED CARNAGE COMPLETE. +30000cr, +100 rep. The whole sector heard about you. No one knows what to do with you.
